fixtures.name: pa
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT i::INTEGER AS id,
  (CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'k' || (i % 13) END) AS g,
  (CASE WHEN i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i * 37 % 100) - 50 END)::INTEGER AS n,
  ((i * 17) % 1000)::BIGINT AS m,
  (CASE WHEN i % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 91) % 2000 - 1000) / 7.0 END)::DOUBLE AS amt,
  (CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (((i * 37) % 20000 - 10000)::DECIMAL(18,2) * 0.01)::DECIMAL(18,2) END) AS p2,
  (CASE WHEN i % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (((i * 53) % 40000 - 20000)::DECIMAL(10,4) * 0.0001)::DECIMAL(10,4) END) AS p4,
  (CASE WHEN i % 13 = 4 THEN NULL ELSE i % 7 END)::INTEGER AS w,
  (CASE WHEN i % 13 = 3 THEN 0 ELSE i % 5 + 1 END)::INTEGER AS z
FROM range(1, 5000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700)

fixtures.name: pw
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT
  'g' || (k % 3) AS gk,
  9223372036854775807::BIGINT AS a,
  3::INTEGER AS small,
  100::TINYINT AS t8,
  (-128)::TINYINT AS t8n,
  200::UTINYINT AS u8,
  20000::SMALLINT AS i16,
  4000000000::UINTEGER AS u32,
  18446744073709551615::UBIGINT AS u64,
  2147483647::INTEGER AS imax,
  (-2147483648)::INTEGER AS imin,
  (CASE WHEN k = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DECIMAL(18,0) AS dz,
  (CASE k % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 0.00 ELSE 0.01 END)::DECIMAL(18,2) AS dc,
  (k * 1000000000 + 7)::DECIMAL(18,0) AS dn,
  1234567.89::DECIMAL(9,2) AS d9,
  1.25::DECIMAL(18,2) AS d18,
  0.1::FLOAT AS f4,
  (k % 7)::DOUBLE / 4 AS dbl
FROM range(0, 201) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 32)
